creator: Codex GPT-6 /root
release_scope: Word-level Hindi-compatible pronunciation leakage in Nepali TTS: vowel deletion and supported vowel-quality contrasts.
main_success: Find additional localized errors beyond the original examples and account for false flags.

steps.title: Freeze the release question and baseline
steps.work: Target localized missing vowels and supported vowel-quality changes in Nepali TTS. Preserve the current working model and all three confirmed examples as regressions. Prosody stays a diagnostic view. Keep one challenger.
steps.deliverable: Pinned baseline, target definitions, and separate discovery / development / new-test manifests.
steps.pass: Existing confirmed cases still work; every result identifies word, interval, cause, and uncertainty.

steps.title: Fix the measurement, then test the new head
steps.work: Check ownership of the focal vowel between its intended consonants. A strong neighboring vowel must not count as evidence at the target. Test the frozen query-only candidate against the reference-conditioned baseline. Expand qualified training with matched same-voice edits and no-change controls.
steps.deliverable: Aim for at least300 qualified training pairs and a fresh test of100 full-vowel deletion / no-change pairs across new word families and conditioning voices. Targets are planned, not achieved counts.
steps.pass: Use the same new test for both frozen models. Challenger promotion target: at least80/100 deletions detected and at most2/100 no-change flags; report grouped uncertainty, exclusions and abstentions. Retain baseline if it fails. Physical-edit performance is not real Hindi-error accuracy.

steps.title: Find additional real TTS cases
steps.work: Search new recordings or newly synthesized sentences, using Native/Hindi G2P disagreement to select sites. Compare original speech, Swar and two approved24-layer Native teacher readings. Keep transcript errors, plausible Native reductions, and weak alignment explicit.
steps.deliverable: Target10 additional occurrences spanning at least5 new words and3 query voices, excluding हैन / किनकि / नेकपा from this discovery target. Provide context and direct word playback.
steps.pass: Report user-confirmed, acoustically supported and unresolved cases separately. A second recognizer is corroboration, not a human label. The already-searched90 cases are retrospective discovery, never a new held-out test.

steps.title: Check false flags and usable coverage
steps.work: Include unchanged speech and available annotated Native variation, with different voices, pitch, gain, speed and references. Measure the fraction of words that can actually be tested. ASR rejects garbled content; it does not certify pronunciation.
steps.deliverable: Frozen evaluation table: controlled-edit recall / no-change flags, real-label results where available, supported-word coverage, abstention rate and processing time.
steps.pass: No source identity labels used as pronunciation truth. Do not quote real-world precision or recall without independently labeled real errors and acceptable controls.

steps.title: Package a research preview for10 November
steps.work: Version minimal code and the selected small heads; verify a clean inference run. Prepare model/data cards, dependency and audio permissions, reproducible commands, and a playable evidence page. Keep the announcement draft separate from publication.
steps.deliverable: Research-preview release candidate: runnable CLI, reviewed examples, measured limitations and a short announcement.
steps.pass: Announce only completed artifacts and measured results. If the challenger fails, the tested baseline and documented discoveries remain the release candidate. Novelty and broad prosody claims require further work.
